title: Add operator documentation, runbooks, and architecture decision records
commit_subject: docs: add operator documentation runbooks and ADRs

markdownlint.config: .markdownlint.jsonc (MD013 line-length off, MD024 siblings_only, MD033 off)
markdownlint.note: Pre-existing docs/design/direct-kvm-subset.md had 24 MD060 table-column-style issues from compact separator rows; normalized the 5 separator rows to padded style (content unchanged) so the gate passes cleanly.

link_check.note: External https/mailto/pure-anchor links excluded; every relative link (including anchors stripped) resolves to an existing file.

template_marker_scan.command: grep -rnE for {{ }} / <!-- Fill|TODO|TBD|FIXME --> / TODO / FIXME / XXX / <TBD> / [TBD] / PLACEHOLDER / Lorem / @@TOKEN@@
template_marker_scan.note: No unresolved template markers in README.md or docs/. Generated examples under schemas/examples/ are JSON, out of markdown scope.

schema_checks.command: grep schema refs + jq parse + $schema draft check
schema_checks.doc_schema_refs_resolved: 7/7 (evidence-benchmark, evidence-deterministic, evidence-host-preflight, evidence-privileged, evidence-security, snapshot-manifest, vm-metrics-record)
schema_checks.note: python jsonschema unavailable offline; full example-against-schema validation was performed in task 3 and all schemas parse as draft 2020-12 here.

benchmark_language_check.command: grep -niE 'target, not sla|reference target|not an sla|no universal|no pass/fail|no pass field'
benchmark_language_check.note: Benchmark docs state target-not-SLA: <200 ms is a measured reference target (target_ms metadata), distributions only (p50/p95/p99), no pass/fail gate, no universal guarantee.

forbidden_claim_audit.command: grep -niE 'production|oci runtime|sla|guarantee' with negation filter + manual review
forbidden_claim_audit.note: Every 'production', 'OCI runtime', and 'SLA'/'guarantee' mention appears only in a negated, disclaimer, or explicit-exclusion context. No positive claim of production readiness, universal latency, general OCI compatibility, or host security beyond the stated TCB.

requirement_topic_coverage.command: grep -rqiE per topic over README.md + docs/
covered: preflight meanings (exit 0/2/77, JSON fields, Bash ioctl limitation)
Unix-socket auth (peer credentials SO_PEERCRED + filesystem mode/ownership)
tenant ownership (owner-scoped ops, cross-tenant denial fail-closed)
snapshot compatibility (manifest hashes, pre-restore CompatibilityGate, CRC-not-auth, no cross-host)
direct-KVM scope (x86_64, 1 vCPU, 16 MiB, 4 exits, feature-gated, educational)

scope_guard.note: No .codegraph/ or .omo/run-continuation/ files modified. Docs-only change; no product code touched, so no cargo re-run required.

acceptance_criteria.runnable_commands_for_preflight: docs/setup.md and docs/runbooks/preflight.md contain runnable commands for both lanes: deterministic (`cargo test --workspace`, `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy -D warnings`, `cargo deny check`) and privileged (`bash scripts/preflight.sh --json .preflight/host.json`, `bash scripts/run-privileged-tests.sh`, `cargo test -p microvm-backend-directkvm --features direct-kvm,privileged`, `cargo test -p microvm-security-tests --features privileged`).
acceptance_criteria.locked_decisions_and_scope_outs_represen: 12 ADRs cover every locked decision (Unix-socket-only, Firecracker-first, transport-neutral service, peer-credential auth + tenant ownership, explicit cgroup-v2, per-VM TAP/netns/NAT, local content-addressed snapshots, local digest artifacts + constrained OCI, hybrid test lanes, direct-KVM educational subset, benchmark distributions-not-SLA, fail-closed TCB). docs/adr/README.md adds a global scope-out register (no TCP, no remote pulls, no general OCI, no cross-host snapshot, no migration/VFIO/clustering/rootless/non-Linux, no production VMM, no universal latency, no silent fallback, no .codegraph/.omo modification).
acceptance_criteria.markdown_link_schema_checks_pass: markdownlint-cli2 0 issues/24 files; 152 relative links resolve; 7/7 schema refs resolve; 17/17 JSON parse; all schemas draft 2020-12.
acceptance_criteria.benchmark_target_not_sla: setup.md, adr/0011, README.md state <200 ms is a measured reference target (target_ms metadata), not an SLA; distributions only; no pass/fail gate; no universal guarantee.
acceptance_criteria.no_unresolved_template_markers: Template-marker scan over README.md + docs/ returns 0 markers outside generated examples.

requirements_coverage.requirement_4_decisions_and_scope_outs: All locked decisions and scope-out rules represented across 12 ADRs + global scope-out register.
